content:
maria: quick follow-up on the qkv+rope unification work — want to align on kernel selection fallbacks if fused path is disabled or fails in inference.

kai: +1. plan is runtime flag `enable_qkv_rope_unify` that routes to fused kernel when available, otherwise fall back to separate q,k,v kernels + rope apply.

jonathan: do we have any deterministic guarantees when toggling between paths? dropout-free paths can change RNG state.

sasha: good catch — dropoutless inference means we should avoid any RNG side-effects. also need to ensure packed layout ABI doesn't shift offsets for cached KV.

kai: proposed runtime config:
```
{
  "enable_qkv_rope_unify": true,
  "fallback_policy": "separate_kernels_on_error",
  "rope_mode": "auto", // options: fused, separate, auto
  "dropout_inference": false
}
```

kai: fallback will log a single-span error + metric `qkv_rope_unify.fallbacks` and route that request to safe path.

deploy-bot: canary for `runtime-v3` with qkv_rope_unify=true started on cluster batch-12 :rocket:

maria: testing plan: microbench (latency p50/p99), kv-cache correctness, deterministic token sequences across paths, and memory regression check. I'll add tests to the harness.

jonathan: add an eval prompt set that stresses long-context rope offsets — saw divergence at 16k when we force fused rope on older kernels.

sasha: also add an ABI-compatibility unit that simulates older quantized kernels (int8) — fused path may assume fp16 layout.

maria: noted. I'll open a follow-up RFC PR with go/no-go criteria and rollout guardrails (canary -> 10% -> 100%), plus alert thresholds for `fallbacks` and quality regressions. :thumbsup:

kai: sounds good. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.
